# 按学习目标阅读

[首页](../README.md) · [主题目录](../papers/README.md) · [年份导航](years/README.md) · [最初 26 篇经典索引](classics.md)

以下是按前置知识和比较问题组织的选读路线，不要求读完全部文章，也不表示每两篇之间存在直接技术继承。年份以条目说明为准。当前导读均为概要，不代表全文精读或实验复现。

## 分类、树模型与表格学习

比较单模型、集成与上下文学习；先掌握监督分类和训练/测试划分。

1. [The perceptron: A probabilistic model for information storage and organization in the brain](../papers/classical-ml/1958-perceptron.md)（1958，传统机器学习）
2. [Nearest Neighbor Pattern Classification](../papers/classical-ml/1967-nearest-neighbor.md)（1967，传统机器学习）
3. [Induction of decision trees](../papers/classical-ml/1986-id3.md)（1986，传统机器学习）
4. [Support-vector networks](../papers/classical-ml/1995-support-vector-networks.md)（1995，传统机器学习）
5. [A Decision-Theoretic Generalization of On-Line Learning and an Application to Boosting](../papers/classical-ml/1997-adaboost.md)（1997，传统机器学习）
6. [Random Forests](../papers/classical-ml/2001-random-forests.md)（2001，传统机器学习）
7. [XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System](../papers/classical-ml/2016-xgboost.md)（2016，传统机器学习）
8. [TabICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for In-Context Learning on Large Data](../papers/classical-ml/2025-tabicl.md)（2025，传统机器学习）

## 概率推断、稀疏建模与优化

先补概率与矩阵运算，区分模型假设、推断近似和参数优化。

1. [Maximum Likelihood from Incomplete Data Via the EM Algorithm](../papers/foundations/1977-em-algorithm.md)（1977，数学、学习理论与概率模型）
2. [Local Computations with Probabilities on Graphical Structures and Their Application to Expert Systems](../papers/foundations/1988-local-probability-computations.md)（1988，数学、学习理论与概率模型）
3. [Latent Dirichlet Allocation](../papers/nlp/2003-lda.md)（2003，自然语言处理与大语言模型）
4. [Regression Shrinkage and Selection Via the Lasso](../papers/foundations/1996-lasso.md)（1996，数学、学习理论与概率模型）
5. [Stochastic Variational Inference](../papers/foundations/2013-stochastic-variational-inference.md)（2013，数学、学习理论与概率模型）
6. [Adaptive Subgradient Methods for Online Learning and Stochastic Optimization](../papers/foundations/2011-adagrad.md)（2011，数学、学习理论与概率模型）
7. [Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization](../papers/deep-learning/2015-adam.md)（2015，深度学习与表征学习）

## 深层网络的训练基础

围绕梯度传播、初始化、正则化和残差连接阅读。

1. [Learning representations by back-propagating errors](../papers/deep-learning/1986-backpropagation.md)（1986，深度学习与表征学习）
2. [Understanding the difficulty of training deep feedforward neural networks](../papers/deep-learning/2010-glorot-initialization.md)（2010，深度学习与表征学习）
3. [Deep Sparse Rectifier Neural Networks](../papers/deep-learning/2011-deep-sparse-rectifiers.md)（2011，深度学习与表征学习）
4. [Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting](../papers/deep-learning/2014-dropout.md)（2014，深度学习与表征学习）
5. [Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift](../papers/deep-learning/2015-batch-normalization.md)（2015，深度学习与表征学习）
6. [Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition](../papers/computer-vision/2016-resnet.md)（2016，计算机视觉）

2. [Histograms of Oriented Gradients for Human Detection](../papers/computer-vision/2005-hog.md)（2005，计算机视觉）
3. [ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks](../papers/computer-vision/2012-alexnet.md)（2012，计算机视觉）
4. [Rich feature hierarchies for accurate object detection and semantic segmentation](../papers/computer-vision/2014-r-cnn.md)（2014，计算机视觉）
5. [Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation](../papers/computer-vision/2015-fcn.md)（2015，计算机视觉）
6. [End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers](../papers/computer-vision/2020-detr.md)（2020，计算机视觉）
7. [Segment Anything](../papers/computer-vision/2023-segment-anything.md)（2023，计算机视觉）

5. [Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision](../papers/multimodal/2021-clip.md)（2021，多模态学习）
6. [BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation](../papers/multimodal/2022-blip.md)（2022，多模态学习）

## 高效微调、对齐与推理

把参数效率、偏好优化和推理预算作为三个不同目标；跨 NLP、系统和强化学习阅读。

1. [LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models](../papers/nlp/2021-lora.md)（2021，自然语言处理与大语言模型）
2. [QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs](../papers/ml-systems/2023-qlora.md)（2023，机器学习系统）
3. [Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback](../papers/nlp/2022-instructgpt.md)（2022，自然语言处理与大语言模型）
4. [Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model](../papers/nlp/2023-dpo.md)（2023，自然语言处理与大语言模型）
5. [DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning](../papers/reinforcement-learning/2025-deepseek-r1.md)（2025，强化学习与决策）
6. [s1: Simple test-time scaling](../papers/nlp/2025-s1.md)（2025，自然语言处理与大语言模型）
